description: On an eight-storey office, the two required exits from each 1,200 m2 floor would be only 4 m apart along an open public corridor. The maximum floor diagonal is 30 m. There is no intervening fire separation that lengthens the smoke path or divides the floor into separate zones. We want to keep both stairs in this compact core.
known_facts: shortest smoke path between exits 4 m
public corridor with no intervening fire separation

missing_info.field: owner or representative contact and property identification
risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and supporting documents
missing_info.why: Alternative-path completeness items; request evidence rather than fabricate a professional conclusion.

gold.departure: The two exits are closer together than the required separation for a floor area with a public corridor.

should_cite.why: Distance is the shortest smoke-travel path.
Check the fire-separated-floor exception, whose conditions the description rules out.

must_not_cite.why: The floor is not divided by the required intervening fire separation.
